introTitle:
A little world.
A shared peace.
introText: Wander a modern neighbourhood where a mosque, a science lab, a hospital, a community kitchen and a coding class sit side by side. There is a story around every corner.
noResults: No stories found. Try another name.
loadingNote: A place for knowledge, care, and connection.
aboutText: Dar al-Salam is an explorable world celebrating mercy, knowledge, justice, hospitality and care in Muslim life today — in labs, clinics, studios, kitchens and classrooms — alongside the heritage that inspired them. This first room is a prototype: its art is procedural, and every story is awaiting research and advisory review.
rule1: No prophet is depicted, in any form, including a figure, silhouette, light, hand, shadow or voice.
rule2: Ahl al-Bayt, the Prophet’s wives, Maryam and the Companions are never depicted.
rule3: Named and ambient characters are checked against a reviewed denylist and exact full-name allowlist.
rule4: Historical cards remain drafts until panel approval. Production builds reject unapproved cards.
rule5: Characters marked “back” face away from the viewer only.
rule6: Everyone wears modest dress. Faces are simple pixel faces with no detailed features.
rule7: Placeholder art contains no sacred text, calligraphy, Qur’an pages or religious symbols.
research: These are demonstration cards. Biographies, stories and citations have not yet been researched.
listText: Lives to discover, modern and historical. Every card is a draft awaiting research and review.
